title: ATN: update some comments.
description:
HTTPS Some More Places.

Instead of giving a now-dead link to a not-archived-in-the-Wayback-
Machine ICAO document repository, give a live link to a PDF of ICAO Doc
9705 Second Edition.

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 4cf64a4ace5ab8b6173b5ad8d3e8a623d2ee09e3 succeeds
